Brahma.name: Brahma Dev
Brahma.note: The creator, first of the devas. Ravana's line springs almost directly from him, Brahma, his mind-born son Pulastya, then Vishrava, then Ravana, a short descent, unlike the long solar line of Rama.

people.Pulastya: A mind-born son of Brahma (a Prajapati); grandfather of Ravana through his son Vishrava.
people.Vishrava: Sage son of Pulastya; father of Kubera by Ilavida and of Ravana and his siblings by the rakshasi Kaikasi.

Kaikasi.note: Rakshasi wife of Vishrava, daughter of the demon Sumali; mother of Ravana, Kumbhakarna, Shurpanakha and Vibhishana.

people.Kubera: Son of Vishrava and Ilavida; the yaksha lord of wealth who first ruled Lanka, until his half-brother Ravana drove him out.
people.Ravana: The ten-headed rakshasa king of Lanka; a mighty devotee of Shiva and master of the Vedas whose abduction of Sita brought his doom.
people.Kumbhakarna: Giant brother of Ravana, cursed to sleep six months at a time; woken for the war, he was slain by Rama.

Shurpanakha.note: Sister of Ravana whose courting of Rama and Lakshmana, and the loss of her nose, set the war in motion.

people.Vibhishana: Youngest brother of Ravana; righteous, he deserted to Rama and was crowned king of Lanka after the war.
people.Indrajit: Meghanada, son of Ravana and Mandodari; he once defeated Indra himself, hence his name, and was slain by Lakshmana.
people.Atikaya: Son of Ravana and Mandodari; a colossal warrior slain by Lakshmana.
people.Akshayakumara: Young son of Ravana, slain by Hanuman in the burning of Lanka.
people.Kumbha: Son of Kumbhakarna, killed in the war.
people.Nikumbha: Son of Kumbhakarna, killed in the war.

Sumali.note: A rakshasa lord of the elder line of Lanka; father of Kaikasi, whom he gave to the sage Vishrava to sire sons who might rival the devas.
